associations.rationale: It places each conjugation-invariant function in the span of irreducible characters, establishing the spanning component but not the full basis claim.
It states linear independence of the irreducible-character family, which is one component needed for the claimed basis but does not itself state the basis assertion.
It identifies the span of irreducible characters with the class-function submodule, giving the spanning component without directly stating that the characters form a basis.
